description: Public artworks, fountains and monuments is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. The City of Melbourne maintains a register of all public artwork, fountains and monuments located within the City. This dataset contains various information regarding the type, category and geographical location of the artwork. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under City Council. Its keywords are accessibility, art, artwork, eventsplanner, fountain, monument. The portal shows 261 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
